newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends at new contract highs on firm cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends at new contract highs on firm cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher and new contract highs were set with firm cash prices for high quality rice again cited as a bullish influence, traders said.
Traders Monday said the Jasmine, or top quality rice in Thailand, was being priced at $560.00 per tonne, well above U.S. paddy rice at $440.00 per ton.
Traders also said China remains an active buyer of top quality rice and the U.S. cash basis remains firm.
The contract high for January is $11.05 per cwt, up from the previous high of $10.98 set Monday.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, below the 1,241 traded Monday.
Rice closed six to 13-1/2 cents per cwt higher, with January up 10 cents at $11.05 per cwt.
